stories.headline: KMT delegation travels to Beijing for think tank exchange with Chinese Communist Party
stories.summary: The KMT announced a delegation led by Vice Chairman Hsiao Hsu-tsen will travel to Beijing February 3-5 for a think tank exchange with the CCP. The DPP criticized the forum as harmful to national dignity, while speculation continues about potential meeting between KMT chair Cheng Li-wun and Xi Jinping.

stories.headline: Opposition parties block DPP defense budget, advance TPP's narrower alternative
stories.summary: The KMT and TPP used their legislative majority to block review of the DPP government's NT$1.25 trillion special defense budget while advancing TPP's own NT$400 billion defense bill covering only five of eight approved weapons systems. The government criticized the move as politicizing national defense.

stories.headline: Central Election Commission certifies six new TPP at-large legislators
stories.summary: The Central Election Commission certified six people to fill vacant Taiwan People's Party at-large legislative seats under the party's 'two-year clause' system, including Li Zhenxiu, a naturalized citizen born in China.

articles.title: Election commission certifies six to fill vacant TPP at-large seats

stories.headline: Eleven KMT members indicted for recall petition forgery
stories.summary: Chiayi District Prosecutors indicted 11 KMT members, including the party's Chiayi City branch secretary-general, for forging over 1,900 signatures in a petition to recall a DPP legislator. They allegedly used the KMT member database to obtain personal information for the fake signatures.

articles.title: Eleven KMT members indicted for recall petition forgery

stories.headline: Taiwan monitors 'abnormal' changes in China's military leadership
stories.summary: Defense Minister Wellington Koo said Taiwan is closely monitoring what it describes as 'abnormal' shifts within China's military leadership following an investigation into China's senior generals. The ministry indicated it would use diverse strategies to assess Beijing's intentions.

articles.title: Taiwan Scrutinizes China Military Leadership Changes After Probe

stories.headline: ROC Armed Forces establish Joint Firepower Coordination Centre
stories.summary: The ROC Ministry of National Defense established a Joint Firepower Coordination Centre within the Armed Forces, based at the Boai Camp in Taipei. The center aims to coordinate asymmetric firepower deployments across military branches, with foreign personnel including US advisors involved.

articles.title: Republic of China Forces Establish 'Joint Firepower Coordination Centre' as U.S. Supplies More Ballistic Missiles
